$comment: Read by tools/check-stories.mjs (pnpm lint). required: for a glob of component files, the story export names each stories file must have (the design gate's states; Tasks 15 to 17 add them with their patterns). coveredBy: a component shown inside another stories file. exempt: a component file with no stories, and why.

exempt.packages/ui/src/components/field.tsx: Internal parts (label, help and error text) of Input, Textarea, Select and Combobox, not exported from the package; shown through those components' stories.
